label: Reach
short: One organisation system connected to an AI tool beyond the built-in Workspace or 365 features, staged.
strong: A tool reads a real system here, set up for the organisation. The next step is a second system, and a rule for which ones.
middle: One person's own setup. The organisation has a demonstration, not a capability. The guide to connecting a model to your systems shows how to make it the organisation's.
edge: Everything is copy and paste. The first connection, with the organisation's knowledge, is the step from chat to work.
unmet: Ask the most technical person here whether any tool, beyond the built-in features, can open the shared drive or an inbox itself.
